title: devbin's next release: the work open after 0.1.35
objective: Each piece of work that was open when devbin 0.1.35 was released is a work package of this thread, not started. The thread is done when each package has shipped in a devbin release, or has moved on with a reason.
context: hv's words of 2026-11-27, through devbin-vc (vc decision 335): close out the week's work, and move all unfinished work into a future, unstarted thread or work package. This thread holds the work open after devbin 0.1.35 that is meant for a devbin release. Each package's body says what it is and where it came from, and its build waits for devbin-vc's word.
